stem:
Tariq's classmates debate offers of tobacco, gutka, cigarettes, beedi, alcohol, and illegal drugs.

Which statements give the right first response? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Refuse tobacco, gutka, cigarettes, and beedi from the first offer because they are harmful and addictive.
Refuse alcohol and illegal drugs from the first offer because they are harmful and addictive.
Alcohol does not need to be refused because it is not an illegal drug.
A cigarette can be tried if there is no breathing difficulty.

teacher.key_rationale: All listed substances are harmful and addictive and should be refused from the first offer. Legality of alcohol does not remove the need to refuse; absence of breathing difficulty does not make a cigarette safe to try.
